events.text: The staging cluster deploys through the blue lane.
We switched the staging cluster to the green deploy lane.

questions.question: Which deploy lane does the staging cluster use now?
Which deploy lane did the staging cluster use before the switch, as retained in memory history?

metadata.notes: IMPLICIT invalidation chain (Hy-Memory 2.0 conflict-candidate expansion slice): the green-lane event never lexically negates the blue-lane event, so a store must resolve the conflict despite no shared negation surface. q-current grades the standard update_correctness contract and FAILS any provider that still returns the superseded blue value beside the current one; q-history grades that the prior lane value remains recallable as history.
